author: Hacken
description: Detector monitors Meltwater media intelligence feeds with advanced filtering

faq.name: How does it work
faq.value: Track media mentions from Meltwater with configurable filters for source, influencer, country, language, reach, social echo, and document tags

faq.name: Feed
faq.value:
Meltwater Feeds URI

Multiple URI's can be specified with comma separation. Supported Feeds: `meltwater://, file://, http://). CSV files can be UTF-16 LE or UTF-8 encoded.

faq.name: Cron
faq.value: Cron interval to check for new posts. Refer to [Cron](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#cron) for more details

faq.name: Max
faq.value: Max number of entries per Feed to process

faq.name: Source Filter
faq.value:
Filter by Source field (e.g., `Open PR,Reuters`)

Comma-separated list. Supports negation with `!` prefix (e.g., `!Spam Source`).

Matching is case-insensitive and uses substring matching.

faq.name: Influencer Filter
faq.value:
Filter by Influencer/Author field (e.g., `John Doe,Jane Smith`)

Comma-separated list. Supports negation with `!` prefix.

faq.name: Country Filter
faq.value:
Filter by Country field (e.g., `us,de,uk`)

Comma-separated list. Supports negation with `!` prefix.

faq.name: Language Filter
faq.value:
Filter by Language field (e.g., `en,de`)

Comma-separated list. Supports negation with `!` prefix.

faq.name: Reach Filter
faq.value:
Filter by Reach field using threshold condition (e.g., `>100000`, `>=50000`, `<1000000`)

Refer to [Condition](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#condition) for more details.

faq.name: Social Echo Filter
faq.value:
Filter by total Social Echo (sum of Twitter, Facebook, Reddit) using threshold condition (e.g., `>500`, `>=100`)

Refer to [Condition](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#condition) for more details.

faq.name: Document Tags Filter
faq.value:
Filter by Document Tags field (e.g., `technology,blockchain`)

Comma-separated list. Supports negation with `!` prefix.

faq.name: Scripts
faq.value:
Scripts to execute on post content

Scripts are executed in the order they are specified. Refer to [Scripts](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#condition-threshold) for more details.

Scripts execution result will be in `result` meta field.

faq.name: Score
faq.value: Condition to filter Alerts score on `result` (result must be in the range: [0..1]). Refer to [Condition](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#condition) for more details

faq.name: Track Error
faq.value: Track Errors as Alerts when feed fetching fails

faq.name: Track Error Always
faq.value:
Track Errors Always

If enabled, the detector will generate an alert for every error, not just the first occurrence.

faq.name: Severity
faq.value: Severity of the Alert. If not specified, defaults to INFO level.

faq.name: Description
faq.value: Description template for the Alert description. Can use any metadata field as placeholder (e.g., `{title}`, `{Source}`, `{Country}`, `{Reach}`)
